original_batch.notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable repository authority. docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md were read before research or grading. Fresh Yamamoto checks covered Jazz House ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, current schedule traces, Space M&A, and credible Japanese-jazz sources. The September 26 TOKU with Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Group BODY&SOUL Grand Finale was reverified from current first-party venue pages but is already represented in curated intake, so no duplicate was created; other verified Yamamoto dates were likewise already represented. A broader US-corridor scan surfaced Zhengtao Pan Jazz Orchestra featuring Chris Potter and Rufus Reid at Zankel Hall on October 10, 2026. Repository-wide searches for Zhengtao Pan and for Chris Potter + Rufus Reid + Zankel returned no matching RADAR record before publication. Stage 1 admits the performance because the announced program is built around new large-ensemble writing rather than generic venue prestige: it includes world premieres of Pan's Concerto for Jazz Orchestra and World Can be a Beautiful Place, a world-premiere Zhengtao Pan arrangement of Brad Mehldau's Unrequited, and a New York premiere arrangement of Nick Finzer's Visions or Mirage, with Chris Potter and Rufus Reid as named special guests. Stage 2 assigns A+: the combination is strong enough to actively make room for if New York is in play, but A+ captures the recommendation without manufacturing scarcity. Although several works are premieres, there is no verified farewell, final appearance, one-time-only claim, or broader historical circumstance that makes missing this particular date a protect-the-night event. The current intake remains visibly broad in A/A+ with S/S+ gated as scarcity tiers; this batch adds A 0 / A+ 1 / S 0 / S+ 0.

events.factual_description: A current Carnegie Hall event listing mirrored by NYC Things identifies Zhengtao Pan Jazz Orchestra featuring Chris Potter and Rufus Reid at Zankel Hall on Saturday, October 10, 2026 at 7:30 PM, presented by Outside In Music. The announced performers are the Zhengtao Pan Jazz Orchestra with Zhengtao Pan conducting, Rufus Reid on bass, and Chris Potter on tenor saxophone and bass clarinet. The published program lists Pan's Endless Cycle, Everything Will Be Alright, World Can be a Beautiful Place (world premiere), Jade Dragonfly, Childhood, and Concerto for Jazz Orchestra (world premiere); Brad Mehldau's Unrequited arranged by Pan (world premiere); and Nick Finzer's Visions or Mirage arranged by Pan (New York premiere). Jeff Nelson's current professional performance schedule independently confirms the Zhengtao Pan Jazz Orchestra at Zankel Hall on October 10 at 7:30 PM, while AXS's current Zankel Hall calendar independently lists the event at the same date and time. The individual orchestra roster beyond the specifically announced conductor and guests, a stable official ticket purchase destination, and official face-value pricing were not published in the accessible verified materials reviewed here and are not inferred.

enrichment.note: The exact Carnegie Hall event destination was discovered through a current event index that links directly to it, but Carnegie Hall's safety-net redirect prevented the research client from rendering that page. Date/time/venue were independently corroborated by performer Jeff Nelson's current schedule and AXS's current Zankel Hall calendar; the current event mirror reproduces the Carnegie listing's billing and detailed premiere program. Zhengtao Pan's first-party site verifies his leadership of the Zhengtao Pan Jazz Orchestra and current catalog, but its events page does not yet list this October date. No stable official ticket link, official face value, full individual orchestra roster, or exact Apple Music destination is supplied.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the writing, not the room by itself. Pan is putting a jazz orchestra through a program with three world premieres and a New York premiere, including a new Concerto for Jazz Orchestra and a first-performance arrangement of Brad Mehldau's Unrequited, then placing Chris Potter and Rufus Reid inside that machinery as featured improvising voices. It is a concrete chance to hear an emerging large-ensemble language tested in public rather than a prestige-venue recital built around familiar material.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play on October 10, actively make room for Zankel Hall and build the evening around the 7:30 set. From the DMV, I would pair it with another New York reason rather than make a dedicated one-night round trip solely for this date.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí el atractivo está en la escritura, no en la sala por sí sola. Pan lleva a su jazz orchestra un programa con tres estrenos mundiales y un estreno en Nueva York, incluido un nuevo Concerto for Jazz Orchestra y una primera versión pública de Unrequited de Brad Mehldau arreglada por Pan; después mete a Chris Potter y Rufus Reid dentro de esa maquinaria como voces improvisadoras destacadas. Es una oportunidad concreta para escuchar cómo se prueba en público un lenguaje emergente de gran ensamble, no un recital de prestigio construido alrededor de repertorio conocido.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego el 10 de octubre, sí le haría espacio a Zankel Hall y armaría la noche alrededor de la función de las 7:30. Desde el DMV, la combinaría con otra razón para subir a Nueva York en vez de hacer un viaje dedicado de una sola noche exclusivamente por esta fecha.
